items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: I love this guy and he was interviewing Randy Newman and asking him about his different situations with writing hit movie scores and things like that and Randy came off being very humble and still [with] the attitude of a student learning. Still with a long way to go and everything like that. They made mention to one of his hit tunes about Los Angeles and his reaction was “Every time they play that I get two hundred and eighty-nine dollars” or something like that.
We get to the mid-seventies and the Italians ask you to start a nonet.
